test_title: RRB Group D Official Paper (Held On: 08 Dec, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Based on the English alphabetical order, three of the following four letter-clusters are alike in a certain way and thus form a group. Which is the letter-cluster that DOES NOT belong to that group?

(Note: The odd one out is not based on the number of consonants/vowels or their position in the letter-cluster.)
solution:
The position and positional values or English Alphabets are:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/8866d0c09ee67277af86585b80027aca2c78c89e9747d9110630c5c47cc79b5b.png] 

The pattern followed here is:

Each letter-cluster pair follows the pattern -1, +4.

1. TSW

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/dd593dd95f72d7422b6a819887a7fee5a588872c8e693f631f81b67830852ac1.png] 

This letter-cluster pair follows the pattern -1, +4.

2. VVY

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/132bb5ecc6112419fc0e763af82317475931fdbf84d5cb9ff71d99d49683ccd4.png] 

This letter-cluster pair does not follow the pattern -1, +4.

3. DCG

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9fdafdfe76de780522b287cf2ae9672ac724c0bb2576deac61aaab0e4d4a5c65.png] 

This letter-cluster pair follows the pattern -1, +4.

4. LKO

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9ae223cc633e388049cc4ee468a48cf2d95e3ac2f0430d055fe9c55a6e38e8ea.png] 

This letter-cluster pair follows the pattern -1, +4.

Thus, VVY is the odd one out.

Hence, the correct answer is "**Option 2**"
